E-commerce

Revamping an Online Store for Higher Conversions

We completely redesigned the user experience, leading to a massive spike in sales.

Cover Image 1

The Challenge

The client's e-commerce platform was experiencing a high cart abandonment rate and low overall conversion rate. The user interface was outdated, the checkout process was clunky, and the mobile experience was subpar.

Our Approach

We conducted a comprehensive UX audit to identify friction points. Based on our findings, we redesigned the entire user journey, focusing on a mobile-first approach, streamlined checkout, and high-quality product visuals. We also implemented strategic upsell and cross-sell placements.

The Results

300% Increase in website traffic

Within the first three months of launch, the client saw a 300% increase in overall traffic and a 150% boost in online sales. The cart abandonment rate dropped by 40%.
